summary: The minor is FEMGEN 299 and FEMGEN 303 (or 303A), and at least three graduate-level FEMGEN electives (numbered 200 and above, not FEMGEN 299 or 303), for 20 units in all; repeated FEMGEN 299 enrollments count toward the 20 up to 6 units of FEMGEN 299, and further electives make up the rest. The one elective you may take in your home department is moved in by hand, and all courses must be taken at Stanford.
